We believe we're a software company, and our leverage comes from engineers writing code. We believe machines are better at pricing assets than humans. This is the definition of adverse selection. It's not a buying opportunity, it's a massive red flag. The result is going to be a consistent high-fidelity view of every single home. Opendoor 2.0 is committed to its community because we're building, because who we're building for matters. I think one of the ways in which we can bring you all along for this journey is to just communicate more frequently, more directly, and tell you what we are doing, what's working, what's not. Thank you, Kaz.
